function.name: update_text_object
function.description: Update a text object (Page, Layout, View, Script, Style, Api, CodeBlock). Top-level arguments are nameOrId, objectType, and updates. oldContent and newContent belong inside each updates item, not at the top level, and nameOrId/objectType do not belong inside updates. Read the current object with read_object_text(showLineNumber=false) before preparing a patch; do not reconstruct it from earlier generated code. startLine is an optional search lower bound on an updates item, not an insertion line: omit it unless needed to disambiguate. To append, match the last nonempty source text and include it plus the appended text in newContent; do not use a displayed EOF blank line as oldContent. Updates apply sequentially and the batch is saved only if all matches succeed. After a match failure, reread the object and rebuild the patch rather than retrying guessed text or line numbers.

nameOrId.description: The unique Identifier (GUID) or Name of the object to be read.

startLine.description: Optional search lower bound, 1 to 2147483647. Omit or null searches from the beginning. This is NOT an insertion position. Never choose a line after oldContent begins; later patches use the text produced by earlier patches.

oldContent.description: Nonempty source text from read_object_text(showLineNumber=false). Exclude display prefixes and preserve actual trailing newlines. For appending, match the final nonempty source fragment and include it before the appended text in newContent.

newContent.description: The replacement text that will overwrite the matched content.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
